# Plage de Saint-Jorioz: Entry Prices and Commune

**Commune (Obec):**
"Saint-Jorioz"

**Admission Prices (Vstupné):**
"Dospělí (18+): 2,60 € · Děti 10–17 let: 1 € · Do 10 let: zdarma · Vstup po 16:30: 1 € · Sezónní permanentka (neomezený vstup červenec–srpen): 22 €"

**Seasonal Conditions:**
The beach operates year-round with free entry from January 30–June and September 1–December 31. Paid admission applies July 1–August 31 (9:30–17:30 with lifeguard supervision). Children under 10 enter free; those 10–17 pay €1; adults pay €2.60. Discounted €1 entry available after 4:30 PM during summer season.
